_provenance.source: FAA d-TPP cycle 2610 instrument approach plates for KACY (the PDFs listed in kacy-procedures.json)
_provenance.method: Glidepath angle / TCH and the missed approach climb altitudes were read from each plate: PDF text layer extracted with pdfjs-dist and the MISSED APPROACH box and TCH labels located by page position; the two USAF plates without a text layer (HI-ILS Y 13, HI-VOR or TACAN 31) were rendered to images and read visually. Every altitude and TCH below equals the figure already transcribed in kacy-procedures.json (plate_notes / missed_approach), except for plates that file lists as not transcribed (KMHT RNP Z 17, RNP Z 35, CAT II-III, SA CAT I), which are new and were read from the plate text layer. HUMAN TRANSCRIPTION - verify against the PDFs before any real use.
_provenance.terms: TCH = threshold crossing height above the runway threshold of the plate's glidepath (GS = ILS glideslope, GP = RNAV glidepath, VDA = visual descent angle of a non-precision approach). It is NOT the VGSI TCH printed in the '(VGSI Angle x/TCH y)' note, which belongs to the visual glide slope indicator (NASR threshold_crossing_height_ft in the facility file).
